title: Variability-driven admission tests for encoder/pairwise reranker profiles
creator: Elena Park
description: Goal: Add a reproducible, variability-focused admission test suite and publishing workflow for embedding + pairwise-reranker model profiles so that pinned versions meet deterministic performance and quality expectations across infra variants. Current problem: onboarding pipelines publish performance profiles based on single-run benchmarks which miss variance spikes (tail latency and accuracy regressions) that customers surface after pinning. This ticket defines tests, thresholds, and an automated gating step in the profile-publish pipeline that rejects a profile if variance bounds or A/B regression checks fail.
acceptance_criteria: A reusable test harness executes N=10 benchmark runs for a candidate encoder+reranker pair across representative infra configs (GPU types, sequence lengths) and produces per-metric mean and 95th-percentile variance.
Profile publisher pipeline ingests the variance report and rejects profile publish if latency P95 exceeds baseline by >15% or embedding/rerank recall@k drops by >2 points.
Pipeline writes standardized metadata into the profile artifact: mean/p95 latency, recall@k mean/stddev, run seed/commit, infra tags.
On rejection, automated failure report (diff vs pinned baseline) is created and posted to the onboarding PR with suggested next steps.
New tests integrated into CI so that surfaced regressions block merges to profiles branch and surface to PM/Design reviewers.
Documentation (Confluence) updated with test methodology and thresholds and a short runbook for triage.
Telemetry: dashboard tile added to Console showing variance trend for recently published profiles.
At least two existing models (one encoder, one pairwise reranker) go through the new flow successfully in canary before wide rollout.
steps: Prototype lightweight harness that runs the existing micro-bench runner in a loop with fixed random seeds and collects latency and quality metrics (Elena)
Define representative infra matrix (a100-ref, rt-80, cpu-quant) and sample sequence-length buckets with Product/Research (Marco + Priya)
Implement variance aggregator service (standalone script initially) that computes mean/std/p95 and serializes as JSON metadata (ENG infra)
Extend profile-publisher to call the aggregator and evaluate rules; implement reject/flag logic and failure reason codes (Marco)
Add CI job to run harness on PRs that touch profile artifacts and surface failure badges in Linear/Triage (SRE involvement)
Create Confluence doc and step-by-step runbook; add runbook link into pipeline failure message (Documentation step)
Canary: run the flow on models: text-encoder-v3 (encoder) and pairwise-ranker-2026a (reranker). Collect feedback and tweak thresholds.
Rollout: enable gating for all embedding/reranker publications; monitor for false positives for 2 weeks.
